Customer called back regarding the same account, but this time about a different issue – they said they'd been trying to log in to the e-edition on their tablet since yesterday and kept getting an error message saying "session expired". I asked if they'd tried clearing the app cache or reinstalling. They said they'd tried reinstalling the app already and it didn't help. Customer said they'd already tried the website on their laptop and that worked fine – it's only the tablet app that's giving trouble. I said that points to the app itself rather than the account. I asked them to delete the app completely, restart the tablet, then reinstall from the App Store. Customer said they'd try that. I also mentioned we've had a few similar reports with the latest app update and that there's a known issue being looked at – if the reinstall doesn't fix it, they can call back and I'll escalate to the tech team. Customer said okay, they'd try the reinstall and call back if it still fails.

– Customer advised to delete app, restart device, reinstall from App Store.
– Known issue with latest app update noted – escalate to tech team if persists.
